result.brief: 提出 CineRecon 基准，用 50 段参考视频与 360 个标注片段评测智能体将视频重建为可编辑动态 3D 场景，并按 Proxy/Simplified/Detailed 三种表征设定与相机、静态、动态一致性维度评估 12 个模型。
result.reason: Benchmark for reconstructing videos as editable dynamic 3D scenes as renderable proxies for controllable video generation; touches 3D/4D scene representation and agentic reconstruction.
